A '''desert tunic''' was a type of tunic. [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru Whitesun Lars]], a simple [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer's]] [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], wore such a tunic.
